cuts.head: tilt
cuts.placeText: a barber shop — a leather barber chair, a wall mirror, a rack of combs and a hot towel steamer
cuts.scene: she is the barber standing with her hands folded beside the leather barber chair, ready for the next cut
cuts.outfit: a barber look fitted to her body — a fitted black vest over a white shirt rolled at the shoulder and a short skirt, bare legs, a double-sided gold comb in her pocket
